column1: # One row routes a recognized tool's output to an existing GENERIC strategy,
# replacing a per-tool parser script. Consulted by the engine before strategy
# auto-detection (disable with --no-hints). First matching row wins; the row
# order in this file is therefore most-specific first.
#   tool        dataset/report name for the match (the tool's identity)
#   match-type  prefix   — first non-blank input line starts with pattern
#               contains — pattern appears anywhere in the input
#               regex    — input matches the bash ERE pattern
#   strategy    an existing generic strategy (strategies/delimited/ or
# Keep patterns distinctive: they are tested against every capture. The corpus
# (tests/corpus/run.sh --golden) verifies rows do not misfire on other tools.
